cnd18:7.1: indriyaparopariyattañāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ. sattānaṃ āsayānusayañāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, yamakapāṭihīre ñāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ mahākaruṇāsamāpattiñāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, sabbaññutañāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, anāvaraṇañāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, sabbattha asaṅgamappaṭihatamanāvaraṇañāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ,

cnd18:21.1: viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo sabbāti bhagavā abhisaṅkhāravasena catasso viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo jānāti, paṭisandhivasena sattaviññāṇaṭṭhitiyo jānāti.
